  }

  const sound = new window.ShoppingAudio({
    onSpeaking:role=>{stage.dataset.speaking=role||'';},
    onAvailability:state=>{
      const note=$('audio-note');
      note.dataset.mode=state.mode;
      note.title=state.detail||'';
      note.innerHTML=`음성: ${escape(state.label||'한국어 AI 음성')} <span class="divider">·</span> 가격·환율·후기는 시나리오 예시`;
    }
  });

  const originalSpeak=sound.speak.bind(sound);
  sound.speak=(text,role,key,ctx)=>{
    document.querySelector('.subtitle-bar').dataset.role=role;
    $('subtitle-speaker').textContent=role==='narrator'?'나레이션':role==='user'?'서연':'AI 글래스';
    $('subtitle-text').textContent=text;
    return originalSpeak(text,role,key,ctx);
  };
  function showTitle(){add(`<div class="title-page"><h2>${escape(window.STORY_TITLE).replace(/\n/g,"<br>")}</h2></div>`);}
  function animate(el, frames, duration=450){
    const a=el.animate(frames,{duration:reducedMotion?1:duration,easing:'cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)',fill:'both'});
    activeAnimations.add(a);
    a.finished.then(()=>activeAnimations.delete(a),()=>activeAnimations.delete(a));
    if(paused) a.pause();
    return a;
  }
  function enter(el){return animate(el,[{opacity:0,transform:'translateY(15px) scale(.985)'},{opacity:1,transform:'translateY(0) scale(1)'}]);}
  function add(html){
    const holder=document.createElement('div');holder.innerHTML=html.trim();
    const el=holder.firstElementChild;overlay.append(el);enter(el);return el;
  }
  function remove(el){
    if(!el?.isConnected)return;
    animate(el,[{opacity:1,transform:'translateY(0)'},{opacity:0,transform:'translateY(-7px)'}],220).finished.then(()=>el.remove(),()=>{});
  }
  function setPhase(phase,label,progress){
    stage.dataset.phase=phase;
    $('phase-label').textContent=label;
    $('playback-status').textContent=paused?'잠시 멈춤':label;
    document.querySelector(`[data-scene="${sceneIndex}"].scene-nav-button`)?.style.setProperty('--progress',`${progress}%`);
  }
  function syncButtons(){
    $('play-label').textContent=running?(paused?'이어서 재생':'일시정지'):(finishedAll?'처음부터 다시 보기':muted?'재생 시작':'소리와 함께 시작');
    $('play-button').querySelector('.play-symbol').innerHTML=icon(running&&!paused?'pause':'play');
    $('play-button').setAttribute('aria-label',$('play-label').textContent);
    $('previous-button').disabled=sceneIndex===0;
    $('next-button').disabled=sceneIndex===scenes.length-1;
    $('sound-button').innerHTML=icon(muted?'mute':'volume');
    $('sound-button').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(muted));
    $('sound-button').setAttribute('aria-label',muted?'소리 켜기':'소리 끄기');
    $('sound-button').title=muted?'소리 켜기':'소리 끄기';
    stage.classList.toggle('is-paused',paused);
  }
  function syncNavigation(){
    for(const button of $('scene-navigation').children){
      const i=Number(button.dataset.scene);
      if(i===sceneIndex)button.setAttribute('aria-current','step');else button.removeAttribute('aria-current');
      button.classList.toggle('completed',completed.has(i));
      if(i!==sceneIndex)button.style.removeProperty('--progress');
    }
  }
  function clearScene(){
    overlay.replaceChildren();
    $('subtitle-text').textContent='';$('subtitle-speaker').textContent='';document.querySelector('.subtitle-bar').removeAttribute('data-role');
    stage.dataset.speaking='';
    for(const a of activeAnimations)a.cancel();
    activeAnimations.clear();
  }
  function stop(){
    runVersion++;
    currentRun?.abort();currentRun=null;
    sound.stop();sound.resume();running=false;paused=false;
    clearScene();syncButtons();
  }
  async function loadScene(index){
    const version=++loadVersion;
    clearScene();
    sceneIndex=index;
    syncButtons();
    const img=new Image();img.src=imageSource(index);
    try{await img.decode();}catch{if(version!==loadVersion)return false;if(!img.complete||!img.naturalWidth)throw new Error('장면 이미지를 불러오지 못했어요. 다시 재생해 주세요.');}
    if(version!==loadVersion)return false;
    sceneIndex=index;
    background.src=img.src;background.alt=scenes[index].alt;
    stage.className=`stage scene-${scenes[index].id}${paused?' is-paused':''}`;
    stage.dataset.scene=String(index);
    $('scene-counter').textContent=`SCENE ${String(index+1).padStart(2,'0')} / ${String(scenes.length).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    if(scenes[index].kind==='intro'){showTitle();$('subtitle-speaker').textContent='나레이션';$('subtitle-text').textContent='재생 버튼을 누르면 이야기가 시작됩니다.';}
    $('scene-title').textContent=scenes[index].title;
    $('scene-subtitle').textContent=scenes[index].subtitle;
    setPhase('scene-only','장면 먼저 보기',0);
    syncButtons();syncNavigation();
    // No scene overlay exists at this point. The scene-only clock starts after decode.
    return true;
  }
  async function selectScene(index){
    stop();finishedAll=false;
    const selectionVersion=loadVersion+1;
    try{await loadScene(Math.max(0,Math.min(scenes.length-1,index)));}
    catch(e){if(selectionVersion===loadVersion)$('playback-status').textContent=e.message;}
  }
  function showQuestion(text){
    return add(`<div class="glass-card user-card" data-layer="user"><span class="speaker-icon">${icon('mic')}</span><p class="user-text">${escape(text)}</p></div>`);
  }
  function scan(x,y,w,h){
    return add(`<div class="scan-box" style="left:${x}px;top:${y}px;width:${w}px;height:${h}px" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><span class="scan-sweep"></span></div>`);
  }
  function showScans(kind){
    if(kind==='request')return [scan(548,250,211,361),scan(805,302,184,319)];
    if(kind==='price')return [scan(698,590,252,163)];
    if(kind==='info')return [scan(542,164,272,507)];
    if(kind==='reviews')return [scan(491,218,239,433)];
    return [];
  }
  const head=(type,title,extra='')=>`<div class="panel-head"><span class="icon-orb">${icon(type)}</span><h2>${title}</h2>${extra}</div>`;
  const row=(label,value,extra='')=>`<div class="info-row reveal-row"><span class="label">${label}</span><strong>${value}</strong>${extra}</div>`;
  const checkMatch=`<span class="match">${icon('check')}일치</span>`;
  const capacity=()=>`<div class="capacity-box reveal-row"><div class="capacity-item"><small>사진 속 제품</small><strong>4g</strong></div><span class="arrow">↔</span><div class="capacity-item actual"><small>매장 제품</small><strong>5g</strong></div></div>`;
  const exampleSources={
    danawa:{name:'다나와',url:'https://www.danawa.com/'},
    oliveyoung:{name:'올리브영',url:'https://www.oliveyoung.co.kr/store/main/main.do'},
    hasaki:{name:'Hasaki',url:'https://hasaki.vn/'},
    shopee:{name:'Shopee VN',url:'https://shopee.vn/'}
  };
  const sourceLink=key=>{
    const source=exampleSources[key];
    return `<a class="source-link" href="${source.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="${source.name} 홈페이지 · 시연용 출처 예시" aria-label="${source.name} 홈페이지 열기 — 출처 표시 예시">${source.name}<span class="external-mark" aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>`;
  };
  function panelHTML(scene){
    if(scene.kind==='compare')return `<section class="glass-card panel compare-panel" data-layer="result">${head('compare','제품 비교 결과')}${row('브랜드','MÂY',checkMatch)}${row('제품·모델','COCONUT MOISTURE',checkMatch)}${row('패키지 디자인','',checkMatch)}${capacity()}<div class="callout reveal-row">${icon('compare')}용량 차이 있음</div></section>`;
    if(scene.kind==='info')return `<section class="glass-card panel information-panel" data-layer="result">${head('search','상품 정보','<span class="pill">베트남어 → 한국어</span>')}<div class="reveal-row"><h3 class="product-name">코코넛 보습 립밤</h3><div class="product-details"><span class="label">브랜드</span><b>MÂY</b><span class="label">모델</span><b>COCONUT MOISTURE</b><span class="label">용량</span><b>5g</b></div><div class="origin-label">${icon('leaf')}베트남 현지 브랜드</div></div><div class="ingredients reveal-row"><h3>대표 성분</h3><div class="ingredient-list"><span class="ingredient-chip"><i class="ingredient-icon"></i>코코넛 오일</span><span class="ingredient-chip"><i class="ingredient-icon shea"></i>시어버터</span><span class="ingredient-chip"><i class="ingredient-icon wax"></i>밀랍</span></div></div></section>`;
    if(scene.kind==='price')return `<section class="glass-card panel price-panel" data-layer="result">${head('price','가격 비교','<span class="pill">동일 제품 · 5g</span>')}<div class="price-row current reveal-row"><div class="price-label-group"><span class="price-label">현재 매장</span><span class="price-source">출처 · 매장 가격표 인식</span></div><span class="price-values"><small>90,000 VND</small><b>약 5,000원</b></span></div><div class="price-row reveal-row"><div class="price-label-group"><span class="price-label">베트남 현지 평균가</span><span class="price-source">예시 · ${sourceLink('hasaki')} · ${sourceLink('shopee')}</span></div><span class="price-values"><small>99,000 VND</small><b>약 5,500원</b></span></div><div class="price-row reveal-row"><div class="price-label-group"><span class="price-label">올리브영 오프라인</span><span class="price-source">예시 · ${sourceLink('oliveyoung')}</span></div><span class="price-values"><b>8,000원</b></span></div><div class="price-row reveal-row"><div class="price-label-group"><span class="price-label">한국 온라인 최저가</span><span class="price-source">예시 · ${sourceLink('danawa')}</span></div><span class="price-values"><b>7,000원</b></span></div><div class="callout reveal-row">${icon('check')}한국 온라인 최저가보다 약 2,000원 저렴</div><p class="disclaimer">가격·환율·사이트 출처는 시연 예시</p></section>`;
    if(scene.kind==='reviews')return `<section class="glass-card panel reviews-panel" data-layer="result">${head('star','후기 요약')}<div class="review-source reveal-row"><span>후기 출처 예시</span>${sourceLink('shopee')}<span class="source-country">베트남</span></div><div class="rating-row reveal-row"><span class="rating-value">4.6</span><span class="rating-total">/ 5</span><div><div class="stars" aria-label="5점 만점">★★★★★</div><div class="review-count">후기 328개</div></div></div><div class="reveal-row"><div class="review-heading">추천 수가 가장 높은 후기<span class="pill">추천 128</span></div><p class="original-review" lang="vi">“Dưỡng ẩm tốt, không quá bết, mùi dừa nhẹ.”</p></div><div class="reveal-row"><p class="translation-label">${icon('translate')}한국어 번역</p><p class="translated-review">보습감이 좋고, 끈적임이 적으며,<br>코코넛 향이 은은함</p></div><div class="keyword-list reveal-row"><span>보습감</span><span>적은 끈적임</span><span>은은한 향</span></div><p class="disclaimer">후기·평점·사이트 출처는 시연 예시</p></section>`;
    if(scene.kind==='summary')return `<section class="glass-card panel summary-panel" data-layer="result">${head('check','확인한 상품 정보')}<div class="summary-row reveal-row">${icon('circleCheck')}상품 정보 확인</div><div class="summary-row reveal-row">${icon('circleCheck')}대표 성분 확인</div><div class="summary-row reveal-row">${icon('circleCheck')}국내외 가격 비교</div><div class="summary-row reveal-row">${icon('circleCheck')}후기 번역·요약</div>${capacity()}<div class="callout reveal-row">${icon('compare')}용량 차이 확인</div></section>`;
    return '';
  }
  async function showResponse(scene,ctx){
    ctx.check();
    setPhase('answer','글래스 UI · 답변',65);
    sound.playEffect('ready');
    const panel=add(panelHTML(scene));
    const rows=[...panel.querySelectorAll('.reveal-row')];
    const reveal=async()=>{
      await ctx.wait(200);
      for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
        ctx.check();enter(rows[i]);
        await ctx.wait(scene.kind==='summary'?330:210);
      }
    };
    const narration=async()=>{
      if(!scene.answer)return;
      await ctx.wait(450);
      const isLong=scene.answer.length>45;
      add(`<div class="glass-card voice-strip${isLong?' long-answer':''}" data-layer="ai-voice"><span class="voice-wave" aria-hidden="true"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></span><p class="voice-copy">${escape(scene.answer)}</p></div>`);
      await ctx.wait(160);
      await sound.speak(scene.answer,'ai',`s${scene.id}-ai`,ctx);
    };
    await Promise.all([reveal(),narration()]);
    ctx.check();setPhase('reading','정보 확인',90);
    await ctx.wait(scene.hold);
  }
  async function playScene(scene,ctx){
    if(scene.kind==='intro'){
      setPhase('narration','도입 나레이션',20);
      await ctx.wait(800);
      await sound.speak(window.STORY_NARRATION,'narrator','intro-narration',ctx);
      ctx.check();
      await ctx.wait(1200);return;
    }
    setPhase('scene-only','장면 먼저 보기',5);
    await ctx.wait(SCENE_ONLY_MS);
    ctx.check();
    let question;
    if(scene.kind==='mode'){background.src=window.SHOPPING_TOUCH_IMAGE;await background.decode();ctx.check();sound.playEffect('activate');await ctx.wait(900);}
    if(scene.question){
      setPhase('question','사용자 발화',25);
      question=showQuestion(scene.question);
      await ctx.wait(100);
      await sound.speak(scene.question,'user',`s${scene.id}-user`,ctx);
      ctx.check();
      await ctx.wait(380);
    }
    if(scene.kind==='mode'){
      remove(question);setPhase('answer','쇼핑 모드 활성화',75);sound.playEffect('ready');
      add(`<div class="glass-card mode-panel" data-layer="result"><span class="icon-orb">${icon('bag')}</span><h2>쇼핑 모드 <span class="mode-on">ON</span></h2></div>`);
      await ctx.wait(scene.hold);
      const follow=showQuestion(window.STORY_FOLLOW);
      await sound.speak(window.STORY_FOLLOW,'user','s0-follow',ctx);ctx.check();
      await ctx.wait(650);remove(follow);return;
    }
    if(scene.kind==='request'){
      remove(question);setPhase('recognition','사진과 실물 비교 중',60);
      showScans('request');
      add('<div class="glass-card recognition-status"><span class="pulse-dot"></span>사진 속 상품 ↔ 손에 든 상품 · 인식 중</div>');
      await ctx.wait(1900);return;
    }
    let marks=[];
    if(scene.question){
      remove(question);setPhase('recognition',scene.kind==='price'?'상품과 가격표 인식':'상품 정보 확인 중',48);
      marks=showScans(scene.kind);
      await ctx.wait(700);
    }
    marks.forEach(remove);
    await showResponse(scene,ctx);
  }
  async function start(index=sceneIndex){
    stop();finishedAll=false;
    const version=runVersion;
    const ctx=new RunContext(version);currentRun=ctx;running=true;paused=false;syncButtons();
    try{
      for(let i=index;i<scenes.length;i++){
        ctx.check();
        if(!await loadScene(i))return;
        ctx.check();
        await playScene(scenes[i],ctx);
        ctx.check();
        completed.add(i);syncNavigation();setPhase('complete','확인 완료',100);
        if(!$('auto-next').checked || i===scenes.length-1){
          running=false;paused=false;finishedAll=i===scenes.length-1;
          $('playback-status').textContent=finishedAll?'전체 시나리오를 확인했어요':'다음 씬을 선택하거나 다시 재생해요';
          syncButtons();return;
        }
        await ctx.wait(450);
      }
    }catch(error){
      if(currentRun===ctx && (error.name!=='AbortError' || ctx.aborted)){
        stop();$('playback-status').textContent=error.message;syncButtons();
      }
    }
  }
  function pause(){
    if(!running||paused)return;
    paused=true;sound.pause();for(const a of activeAnimations)a.pause();
    $('playback-status').textContent='잠시 멈춤';syncButtons();
  }
  function resume(){
    if(!running||!paused)return;
    paused=false;sound.resume();for(const a of activeAnimations)a.play();
    $('playback-status').textContent=$('phase-label').textContent;syncButtons();
  }
  $('scene-navigation').innerHTML=scenes.map((s,i)=>`<button class="scene-nav-button" data-scene="${i}" aria-label="씬 ${i+1}: ${s.title}"><span class="nav-number">${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span>${s.short}</span></button>`).join('');
  $('scene-navigation').addEventListener('click',event=>{const button=event.target.closest('button');if(button)selectScene(Number(button.dataset.scene));});
  $('play-button').addEventListener('click',()=>{sound.unlock();if(running){paused?resume():pause();}else start(finishedAll?0:sceneIndex);});
  $('replay-button').addEventListener('click',()=>{sound.unlock();start(sceneIndex);});
  $('previous-button').addEventListener('click',()=>selectScene(sceneIndex-1));
  $('next-button').addEventListener('click',()=>selectScene(sceneIndex+1));
  $('home-button').addEventListener('click',event=>{event.preventDefault();selectScene(0);});
  $('sound-button').addEventListener('click',()=>{muted=!muted;sound.setMuted(muted);if(!muted)sound.unlock();syncButtons();});
  $('fullscreen-button').addEventListener('click',async()=>{
    try{if(document.fullscreenElement)await document.exitFullscreen();else await document.body.requestFullscreen();}
    catch{$('playback-status').textContent='이 브라우저에서는 창을 크게 해서 감상해 주세요';}
  });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)pause();});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
    if(event.target.matches('button,input,a'))return;
    if(event.code==='Space'){event.preventDefault();$('play-button').click();}
    if(event.code==='ArrowRight')$('next-button').click();
    if(event.code==='ArrowLeft')$('previous-button').click();
  });
  function resize(){canvas.style.transform=`scale(${stage.clientWidth/1600})`;}
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(stage);resize();
  for(const [id,name] of [['fullscreen-button','fullscreen'],['replay-button','replay'],['previous-button','prev'],['next-button','next']])$(id).innerHTML=icon(name);
  stage.classList.add('scene-0');stage.dataset.scene='0';stage.dataset.phase='scene-only';
  loadScene(0).catch(e=>{$('playback-status').textContent=e.message;});
  syncButtons();syncNavigation();
  // Readiness and preloading never insert an overlay or start playback.
  background.addEventListener('load',()=>{if(!running)$('playback-status').textContent='장면부터 천천히 시작해요';},{once:true});
  for(let i=1;i<scenes.length;i++){const preloaded=new Image();preloaded.src=imageSource(i);}
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
